title: Can Skipping Breakfast for 7 Days Melt Belly Fat?

scenes.text: Can skipping breakfast for 7 days melt belly fat?
Many think that never eating in the morning automatically leads to weight loss.
scenes.label: Skipping breakfast burns fat

scenes.text: Research shows that overall calorie balance matters more than meal timing; skipping breakfast can even increase hunger later, making weight control harder for most people.
scenes.label: Total calories decide weight

scenes.text: Instead of ditching breakfast, choose protein‑rich options to curb cravings.
scenes.label: Protein‑rich start

scenes.text: Follow for daily tips to feel your best.

description: Skipping the morning meal isn’t a magic fat‑burner. Discover why calorie balance and smart food choices matter more than timing. Stay tuned for everyday health hacks.
